$comment: Teacher Tools registry. Order is the order on /tools/. Every tool: pick -> customize -> preview live -> export; works offline; drafts saved on the device.

tools.title: Game Maker
tools.summary: Paste a word list or questions. Get a classroom game in six styles that runs offline, as one file, a link or printable cards.

tools.title: Activity Builder
tools.summary: Stack blocks (passage, audio, multiple choice, drag to order, cloze, frames, rubric) into one interactive page.

tools.title: Objective + Sentence Frame Generator
tools.summary: Choose a content area, topic and Key Language Use. Get a content objective, a language objective and frames in three proficiency bands.

tools.title: Scaffold Generator
tools.summary: Paste a task or text and pick a level. Get chunked text, simpler directions, a glossary, a graphic organizer and frames.

tools.title: ACCESS Score Interpreter
tools.summary: Enter domain levels for one student or a class. See composite estimates, plain-language meaning, next steps and a family letter in English and Spanish.

tools.title: Vocabulary Card Builder
tools.summary: Make printable Frayer-model and picture cards with Tier 2/3 labels, Spanish and cognate notes.

tools.title: Graphic Organizer Library
tools.summary: Printable and fillable organizers for Narrate, Inform, Explain and Argue.

tools.title: ACCESS Readiness Kit
tools.summary: A test-day checklist, a headset and microphone check, a practice walk-through of an online test screen, and a family letter.

tools.title: Warm-Up Generator
tools.summary: A five-minute language warm-up for any content area and level, ready to project.

tools.title: Practice Playlist Maker
tools.summary: Choose practice sets in the order you want. Share one link or QR code. Students see their own progress on their device; no accounts and nothing collected.
